THE CARE GUIDE

A little care.
A lasting ritual.

Give your favourite pieces the attention they deserve.

01 / WEAR

Last on. First off.

Put jewellery on after applying skincare, makeup, and perfume. Remove it before showering, swimming, sleeping, or exercising.

02 / CLEAN

Keep it gentle.

Wipe away surface oils with a soft, dry cloth after wearing. Avoid abrasive materials, household cleaners, and unverified jewellery cleaning solutions.

03 / STORE

A space of its own.

Keep each piece separately in a soft pouch or lined compartment. Fasten necklaces before storing and keep your collection away from moisture.

GOOD TO KNOW

Your care
questions, answered.

Can I wear jewellery in water?

The safest general approach is to remove it before bathing or swimming. Water, chlorine, and salt can affect finishes and some stones. Follow your piece's material-specific care instructions.

How should I look after plated pieces?

Minimise friction and contact with moisture, perfume, and lotions. Use a soft cloth gently; polishing compounds can wear away a plated surface.

Can every gemstone be cleaned the same way?

No. Porous, treated, or delicate stones may need special care. Avoid soaking or ultrasonic cleaners unless a jeweller confirms they are suitable for your particular piece.

What should I do if a clasp or setting feels loose?

Stop wearing the piece and have a qualified jeweller inspect it. Avoid trying to tighten a setting or repair a delicate chain yourself.
